# Marketstack

Stock Data Real-Time, Intraday & Historical Market Data API providing access to 125,000+ tickers across 72+ stock exchanges worldwide

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/marketstack/.

## Actions

- **Get Dividends** (read-only): Retrieve stock dividend data for one or more ticker symbols from Marketstack API.
- **Get End-of-Day Data** (read-only): Retrieve end-of-day (EOD) stock data for one or multiple ticker symbols.
- **Get Ticker EOD Data** (read-only): Retrieve end-of-day stock price data for a specific ticker symbol.
- **Get Ticker EOD Latest** (read-only): Retrieve end-of-day (EOD) stock data for the latest available date for a specific ticker.
- **Get Ticker Info** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about stock tickers including exchange, sector, and industry data.
- **List Stock Exchanges** (read-only): Retrieve information about supported stock exchanges.
- **List Tickers** (read-only): Get a list of all supported stock tickers.
- **Get Exchange Info** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific stock exchange by its MIC (Market Identifier Code).
- **Get Stock Splits** (read-only): Retrieve stock split data for one or more stock symbols from Marketstack.
- **List Currencies** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all supported currencies from the Marketstack API.
